title: Behre zikre murtaza irfane dawar chahiye
body:
Behre zikre murtaza irfane dawar chahiye
Ulfate noore khuda ko dil munawwar chahiye
<<DIVIDER>>
Ulfate shaahe wilayat kaam kuch aasaa'n nahi
Qalbe salma'n chaahiye Qoo-e- Abuzar chahiye
<<DIVIDER>>
aati hai roomaal lekar majliso me fatima
nazr dene ke lie aansu ke gouhar chahiye
<<DIVIDER>>
dhoop me jalti zamee'n par zibha hote hai hussain
daamane paake nabi zahra ki chaadar chahiye
<<DIVIDER>>
kehte the abid jinhe raahat mile wo aur hai
hum ghareebo ke lie kaanto ka bistar chaahiye
<<DIVIDER>>
kehke ye sajjade muztar ne pehenli bediya'n
thaam ne kashti ko ummat ki ye langar chahiye
